posts.cooked:
Six years ago (almost seven now), they had a ten year plan. They didn’t make it …

Nobody back in the day had ANYTHiNG to say about the first name-drop of Xxxhulish?

I don’t know who the ripped Russian with armor was.

It has nothing to do with this episode, but I had a fun mental image of some person being like “You never really loved me, sob; you’re just using me for my Sentinel Comics lore!” It’d have been a great line for Christopher to use at the end of some letter.

Guise acts as if he could break the fourth wall, that doesn’t mean it’s true. Although, on the other One-Shot bar, I think we have an answer to that old philosophical poser, “Can Guise shapeshift into a rock so heavy that even he can’t lift it?”
posts.raw:
Six years ago (almost seven now), they had a ten year plan.  They didn't make it ...

Nobody back in the day had ANYTHiNG to say about the first name-drop of Xxxhulish?

I don't know who the ripped Russian with armor was.

It has nothing to do with this episode, but I had a fun mental image of some person being like "You never really loved me, sob; you're just using me for my Sentinel Comics lore!"  It'd have been a great line for Christopher to use at the end of some letter.

Guise acts *as if* he could break the fourth wall, that doesn't mean it's true.  Although, on the other One-Shot bar, I think we have an answer to that old philosophical poser, "Can Guise shapeshift into a rock so heavy that even he can't lift it?"
